title: xAI Adds X DM Access and Coinbase, Robinhood Connectors to Grok Bot

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Grok Bot is now capable of managing private direct messages on X and linking to account data from third party services including Coinbase, Robinhood, eToro, Trello, PostHog and beehiiv. Users can trigger actions or initiate research by tagging @bot under any post on the social platform. Additional updates improve memory for voice calls, refine notifications to appear only on the active device, and enable the assistant to draft responses and sort through direct message requests.

These enhancements expand on version 0.70.2, which integrated the tool into Grok web and mobile apps and provided 3x faster computer task processing. Previous releases introduced @mail.grokbot.com addresses and interactive chat cards for Figma and Notion. To prevent unauthorized activities, xAI requires user approval before the bot executes irreversible actions such as making payments or deleting personal data.

selectedTweets.text:
Grok Bot just got a massive upgrade!

Here’s what’s new:
- 3x faster computer tasks
- Replies in less than half the time
- Faster voice calls with better memory
- Access to your X Chat messages
- Tag @bot on X to get things done
- Smarter email automations
- New connectors: Robinhood, Coinbase, Trello, PostHog, beehiiv and more
- Cleaner UI and better notifications

The speed improvements alone are huge

selectedTweets.text:
🚨 Grok Bot just got 3x faster, and that's the least useful part of the update

what actually changed:
> computer tasks finish 3x sooner on average, other replies in less than half the time
> tag @bot under any post on X and it gets to work
> it reads your X Chat now, connect X and let it work your DMs
> email plus aliases, so a routine can fire only on mail sent to one address
> new connectors: Robinhood, Coinbase, Trello, PostHog, beehiiv, eToro
> voice calls remember past conversations better
> notifications only go to the device you're using

try these first:
> give newsletters their own plus alias and one routine that reads only that
> connect X and ask it to sort your DM requests
> drop it under a long thread and ask for the 3 points that matter

Also interesting to see how Grok Bot is slowly capturing the space where OpenAI Dots and Muse are not available.
